featureReviews.notes: Silhouette holds (Tier-1 IoU 0.898): top, six legs, stretchers, end X braces, blade and log in place.

After the refine-spec the arbor hub is round (16-sided) and about a quarter of the blade diameter, sitting at the blade centre just above the top line like the reference's boss; it still reads flat black until the iron material lands.
Stretchers on the outer leg faces front and back, back pair visible through the gaps; X braces at both ends read in the side views.
Log is now round (16 sides) and rests in front of the blade's right half; the pale cut face is still to come (micro).
